infrastructure_evidence_packet.description: Evidence produced by Infrae actions (rollback results, capacity tests, deployment verification).
infrastructure_evidence_packet.title: Infrastructure evidence packet

infrastructure_truth_packet.description: State truth established by Infrae before infrastructure mutation.
infrastructure_truth_packet.title: Infrastructure truth packet

repository_evidence_packet.description: Evidence produced by Getter while mutating repository state (merge/rebase/reset/revert results, integrity checks).
repository_evidence_packet.title: Repository evidence packet

repository_truth_packet.description: Freshness-carrying truth packet for the Gitter → Getter handoff. Composes the common handoff envelope; domain data lives in the nested payload (repository / change / assessment / freshness).
repository_truth_packet.title: Gitter repository truth packet

tui_validation_packet.description: Validation packet emitted by tuid after exercising terminal UI rendering/behavior.
tui_validation_packet.title: Tui validation packet

manifest.name: Infrae
manifest.purpose: Model and control infrastructure changes using bounded evidence and recovery paths.

stateworks.runtime_capsule:
# Infrae — StateWork
Domain: infrastructure_state
Purpose: Model and control infrastructure changes using bounded evidence and recovery paths.
Workflow engine: state_machine (state-machine/v1)
Available flows:
- assess
- change
- decommission
- design
- discover
- incident
- migrate
- model
- recover
- scale
- validate
Inspect current workflow progress and eligible steps through the host workflow authority.
Use the selected flow as guidance; the workflow contract and host authority determine legal steps.
